publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
reliability: Primary agency description of its workflow/rule; reliable within stated scope, not independent customer-demand evidence. HTTP 200 public HTML read on access date.
findings: Covered contractors and subcontractors must submit weekly certified payroll information; using WH-347 specifically is optional.
The instructions require reporting hours by labor classification and address wage/fringe benefit treatment and a signed Statement of Compliance.

The Public Burden Statement estimates an average of 55 minutes for the information collection, including review, data gathering, completion and checking; this is an agency estimate, not measured small-contractor time.
limitations: Instructions are authoritative about this federal reporting workflow, not evidence of dissatisfaction, error prevalence, willingness to pay, or the performance of existing software.
The 55-minute estimate does not establish per-worker, per-project annual cost, a small-business subgroup, a distribution, or avoidable time. No such extrapolation is made.
title: Instructions For Completing Davis-Bacon and Related Acts Weekly Certified Payroll Form, WH-347

history.reason: Initial public-source discovery for issue #4; no customer interviews or commercial validation.
